map.HOMA-IR 与 HOMA-β 要结合看吗？: Should HOMA-IR and HOMA-beta be read together?
map.是。HOMA-IR 高提示抵抗，HOMA-β 高提示 β 细胞仍在代偿；若 β: Yes. A high HOMA-IR suggests resistance, while a high HOMA-beta suggests the beta cells are still compensating; if beta cell function declines while IR persists, it points toward impaired glucose tolerance or diabetes.
map.研究中使用要注意什么？: What should be noted when using it in research?
map.需统一空腹条件、胰岛素检测方法（RIA vs CLIA 结果不可直接比），并在论: Fasting conditions and the insulin assay method must be standardized (RIA and CLIA results are not directly comparable), and the source of the cut-off must be reported in the paper.
